title: Page 7
content_zh:
费明兰倾听着母亲的温柔教诲，才陡然意识到自家母亲其实什么都明白，人情世故什么都懂，她只是不在乎，只是看淡了看开了，万事不牵挂而己。

或许，母亲汉样的心态才是最聪明的，让自己少争少欲，安然恬淡于自己的兰草世界里，反而让父亲更加疼爱她看重她，觉得与她在一起轻松自在，没有任何压力。

不争，即是大争。

或许，这才是父亲几十年如一日爱宠母亲的原因？

毕竟，母亲虽然秀美，却也不算国色天香，而且以色事人者，又有几人能长久？色衰而爱弛，亘古真理。

只有真正的爱重，才能让夫妻二人真心为对方着想，体贴入微。

母亲能忍下嫉妒，主动为他纳妾生子：而父亲也能为了母亲，将自己儿子的生母远嫁他乡，就为了不再惹母亲不开心。

世间没有十全十美，生活总是在人们不经意的时候制造难题，唯有始终同心同德才能共偕白首、恩爱百年吧？

「当时我虽然是隐忍了，心里终归是委屈的。可是……和现在相比，就算再多给他纳几个美妾，生几个庶子又算什么？」费郑氏说着说着眼泪就无声地流了下来，她抬手用手帕掩盖住眼帘，声音已经呜咽。「只要他还活着，哪怕不健康，哪怕需要我整日伺候着呢？」

「娘……」

母女俩抱头失声痛哭。

纳妾生庶子，会让嫡妻的心如刀割，可是与生命相比，这些又算什么？

人没了，才真的万事皆空，心如死灰，刀割都不会痛了。

女人的幸福，真是需要太多太奢侈太苛刻的条件。

时也，运也，命也。

人生短短几十年的种种际遇，要想幸福快乐，半是人为半是缘于天定，绝非个人主观努力就能得到的。

所以人在必要的时候，很是需要学会豁达，学会自我开解，学会「难得糊涂」，这不是懦弱，也不是妥协，而是实实在在的生活智慧。

费郑氏情绪缓和一点之后，才总结道：「原公子如果再抗旨，大概只有被砍头了，那时候然才连哭都没地方哭去，所以要想开点。知道，吗？」

费明兰的心情终于也走出了死胡同，钻出了牛角尖，己经没有最初的那种尖锐绝望之痛了。

她点了点头，「娘，我已经明白了。」

「娘希望你是真的明白了，日后你真的出嫁了，夫妻相处之道其实大有学问，要多用心思，但莫耍心机：不能没心眼，该用的手段也得用，但要多站在他的立场想一想。再体贴的男人，喜欢的也是柔美的花儿，而不是尖锐的花刺。他可以包容你一次两次，但不会包容一辈子。」

「嗯。」

「不过，该强的时候也要强，原则立场半步不能退让，否则你一步退就会步步退，最后完全任人宰割。夫妻之间的底线，就是要让他的心始终如一地在你身上，其他的，都是小矛盾小问题了。夫妻之间，妻妾之间，母子之间，只要你牢牢抓住这一道底线，就会永远立于不败之地。」

费明兰忍不住擦了擦眼角的泪花，破涕为笑道：「娘，爹爹知道你其实有这么多小心眼和小手腕吗？」

费郑氏笑得温婉，又带着一种浓浓的满足，「他什么都知道，而且还故意纵容着我呢。」

「娘，女儿其实很羡慕您呢！」

「傻闺女，娘希望你要比我更幸福更快乐才好。娘是因为自幼体弱，不易受孕，所以才有了婚后那段波折。而你自幼就健康，娘还特意一直为你调养身体，希望日后好生养，多子多福。」

费明兰「嗯嗯」应着，心情终于慢慢平和。

怕什么呢？

就像娘说的，只要原治之的心在自己身上，他们就能走过各种考验与打击。

如果原治之的心不在她的身上了，她就更没有必要为一个无情的男人而痛苦不堪、折磨自己了。

第9章(2)

小丫鬟在帘外禀报原公子前来探访的时候，费明兰歪在床榻上睡着了。

自从得到原治之惊变的消息后，她就立即从余姚县赶去京城，又从京城返回来，接着又受到了「侧室事件」的打击，让她实在是不堪承受，疲惫终于击垮了她，在母亲怀里沉沉睡去。

费郑氏坐在床沿边，手还握着女儿的纤纤玉手，半是怜惜半是若有所思地注视着她。

其实，完婚之前就给明兰这样一个沉重打击，或许是好事。

自己的女儿自己最了解，明兰性子太要强，万事又力求完美，继承了父亲坚强独守的性格，偏偏生为女儿身，这并非好事。

俗话说「过刚易折」，就像她在父亲骤然去世后，居然想凭借着她一个女儿家的柔弱肩膀支撑起这个皇商之家，她培育兰花都失去了真正的赏兰、爱兰的情趣，更在意起利益得失，这种情形太不妙了。

她上面有兄长，虽然是庶出，但却是老爷生前定下的继承人。

她还有自己这位亲生母亲，虽然自己一向不爱管理家产之事，但是总比她多活了大半辈子，路过的桥比她走过的路还多吧？没能耐，起码还有点见识吧？

她居然都不想与兄长和母亲商议，只是一个人苦苦支撑，靠着卖兰花的钱去维系皇商的官商途道与人脉关系，既倔强又憨傻。

她还总是自以为自己，得了商人之精髓，其实啊，就是傻闺女一个。

倒是那个原治之，才是个真正厉害的角色，也是个狠得下心取舍的男人。

自从接到原夫人郑氏的书信后，费郑氏认真打发了几个家人去京城打听过原治之从小到大的事迹，也从自己娘家那边得到了回音，汉人确实是个独特的人才。

说他是人才，是因为他有功名，而且还考中了探花。说他独特，却是因为他没有走寻常士人的文官之路，而是代替皇帝管理起了天下商户。

费郑氏经常叹息着对亡夫念叨，如果费忠贵还活着，他恐怕会格外欣赏和喜爱这个准女婿吧，他们一定会有很多的共通话题，只可惜……

正因为如此，费郑氏倒|对原治之放下了心，她相信一个能和自己丈夫有共同之处的男人，不会太差。

时下世人眼中的商人多是奸险狡诈，为富不仁，似乎就没有好人，商人人品最容易遭到猜忌。

可是费郑氏听费忠贵讲过，真正的顶级大商人，以天地为货仓，以人心为秤杆，以诚信为准星，衡量的是大利益大得失，就算失败到一无所有，也可潇洒来去。

商者，通天下也。

这样的一个男人，心中自有天地，自有准则，他们对待自己认定的人，不离不弃，会倾尽一切来疼爱呵护。

所谓日久见人心，日子一久才能看出谁的人品更高贵，谁的感情更坚贞。

费郑氏希望自己的女儿能坚定自己的心，不要为外界的干扰而动摇，一份真正的感情得来不易，维系更艰难。

费郑氏自己此生的经历已经让她深有体会，她希望自己的女儿能够比自己走得更顺些，更少些心理挣扎与折磨。

在完婚前就经历了此后可能要遇到的波折，有了心理准备，总比完全沉浸到两人恩爱世界后，再被打破美好幻象来得好。

在这个男权至上，允许男人一妻多妾的社会早，富贵之家要想完全摒绝侍妾，多少有点流于幻想，属于女人的一相情愿而己。

既然现实如此残酷，对待女人如此严苛，那么身为妻子，就不应该一味傻傻的吃醋眇闹，而应该更变通玲珑些，将男人的心笼络住，日子才能真正好过。
content_en:
Fei Minglan listened to her mother's gentle teachings, and suddenly realized that her mother actually understood everything, and she knew everything about people and the world. She just didn't care, she just looked down and looked away, and she didn't worry about everything.

Perhaps the mother's masculine mentality is the smartest thing. She allows herself to fight less and be content with her orchid grass world. This makes her father love her more and value her more, making her feel relaxed and comfortable with her without any pressure.

If there is no fight, there will be a big fight.

Perhaps this is the reason why my father has loved and doted on my mother for decades?

After all, although the mother is beautiful, she is not beautiful, and how many people can last long if they use sex to serve others?When love fades, love fades. This is an eternal truth.

Only true love can make a couple truly consider each other and be considerate.

The mother could bear her jealousy and take the initiative to take a concubine and give birth to a son for him; and the father could also marry his son's biological mother to a foreign country for his mother's sake, just so that he would no longer make his mother unhappy.

Nothing in the world is perfect, and life always creates problems when people don't expect it. Only by always working together can we live together and love each other for hundreds of years, right?

"Although I tolerated it at the time, I felt aggrieved after all. But...compared to now, even if I give him a few more beautiful concubines, it doesn't matter how many bastards I have?" Fei Zheng's tears flowed down silently as she spoke. She raised her hand to cover her eyes with a handkerchief, her voice already sobbing."As long as he is alive, even if he is not healthy, even if he needs me to take care of him all day long?"

"Mother..."

The mother and daughter held their heads and cried bitterly.

Taking a concubine and giving birth to a concubine will make the legitimate wife's heart feel like a knife, but compared with life, what are these?

When the person is gone, everything is really empty, the heart is as gray as ashes, and even a knife will not hurt.

A woman's happiness really requires too many, too luxurious and harsh conditions.

Time, luck and destiny.

All kinds of encounters in just a few decades of life. If you want to be happy, it is partly man-made and partly determined by God. It cannot be achieved by individual subjective efforts.

Therefore, when necessary, people need to learn to be open-minded, learn to understand themselves, and learn to "rarely be confused." This is not cowardice or compromise, but real life wisdom.

After Fei Zheng calmed down a little, she concluded: "If Mr. Yuan resists the order again, he will probably be beheaded. At that time, there will be no place to cry, so I have to be more open-minded. Do you understand?"

Fei Minglan's mood finally came out of the dead end, and the pain of despair was no longer the same as before.

She nodded, "Mom, I understand."

"Mom, I hope you really understand that when you get married in the future, there is actually a lot of knowledge in how to get along with a husband and wife. You have to be more considerate, but don't be scheming: you can't be careless, and you have to use the means you need, but you have to put yourself in his position. No matter how considerate a man is, he likes soft flowers, not sharp thorns. He can tolerate you once or twice, but he will not tolerate you for a lifetime."

"Yeah."

"However, you must be strong when you should be strong. Don't give in on your principled stance. Otherwise, if you take one step back, you will retreat step by step, and in the end you will be completely at the mercy of others. The bottom line between husband and wife is to keep his heart always on you. Everything else is just a small conflict. Between husband and wife, between wives and concubines, between mother and son, as long as you firmly grasp this bottom line, you will always be invincible."

Fei Minglan couldn't help but wiped the tears from the corners of her eyes, and said with a smile through tears: "Mom, does daddy know that you are actually so petty and mean?"

Fei Zheng smiled gently, with a deep sense of satisfaction, "He knows everything, and he even indulges me on purpose."

"Mom, my daughter is actually very envious of you!"

"Silly girl, I hope you will be happier and happier than me. My mother was weak since she was a child and had difficulty conceiving, so she had the troubles after marriage. And you have been healthy since you were a child, and your mother has been taking good care of your body. I hope you will have good fertility and have many children in the future."

Fei Minglan responded with "Yeah, yeah" and her mood finally calmed down.

What are you afraid of?

Just like what my mother said, as long as Hara Zhizhi's heart is in her, they can go through all kinds of tests and blows.

If Hara's heart was no longer with her, there would be no need for her to suffer and torture herself for a heartless man.

Chapter 9(2)

When the little maid reported from outside the curtain that the former master had come to visit, Fei Minglan was lying on the bed and fell asleep.

After receiving the news of Yuan Zhi's sudden change, she immediately rushed from Yuyao County to the capital and returned from the capital. Then she was hit by the "concubine incident", which made her unbearable. Exhaustion finally defeated her, and she fell asleep in her mother's arms.

Fei Zheng sat on the edge of the bed, still holding her daughter's slender hand, looking at her with half pity and half thoughtfulness.

In fact, it might be a good thing to give Minglan such a heavy blow before getting married.

My daughter knows best. Minglan is too strong-tempered and strives for perfection in everything. She inherited her father's strong and independent character, but she was born a daughter. This is not a good thing.

As the saying goes, "Strength is easy to break." Just like after her father's sudden death, she actually wanted to support the royal merchant family with the weak shoulders of one of her daughters. She had lost the real interest in appreciating orchids and loving orchids when cultivating orchids, and she was more concerned about profit and loss. This situation is not good.

She has an elder brother, and although she is a concubine, she is the heir appointed by the master during his lifetime.

She also has her biological mother. Although she has never liked managing family property, she has lived more than half her life and passed more bridges than she has walked, right?I have no ability, but at least I have some knowledge, right?

She actually didn't want to discuss it with her brother and mother. She just struggled to support it by herself, relying on the money from selling orchids to maintain the official and business connections of the imperial merchants. She was both stubborn and stupid.

She always thinks that she has the essence of a businessman, but in fact, she is just a stupid girl.

Hara Haruyuki, on the other hand, is a truly powerful character and a ruthless man who can make choices.

After receiving the letter from the original wife Zheng, Fei Zheng sent several family members to the capital to inquire about Yuan Zhizhi's deeds from childhood to adulthood. He also received feedback from his natal family that the Han people were indeed a unique talent.

He is said to be a talent because he has a good reputation and got the top prize in the exam.He was unique because he did not follow the path of an ordinary scholar as a civil servant, but managed merchants all over the world on behalf of the emperor.

Fei Zheng often sighs and talks to her deceased husband. If Fei Zhonggui was still alive, he would probably appreciate and love this prospective son-in-law very much. They must have many topics in common, but it's a pity...

Because of this, Fei Zheng felt relieved about Yuan Zhizhi. She believed that a man who had something in common with her husband would not be too bad.

Nowadays, most businessmen in the eyes of the world are cunning, cunning, and unkind for the sake of wealth. It seems that there are no good people, and the character of businessmen is most likely to be suspected.

But Fei Zheng heard Fei Zhonggui say that the real top businessmen use heaven and earth as their warehouses, people's hearts as the scales, and integrity as the crosshairs. They measure big interests and big gains and losses. Even if they fail and lose everything, they can come and go with ease.

A businessman has access to the world.

Such a man has his own world and principles in his heart. They will never leave the person they identify with and will do everything they can to love and care for them.

As time goes by, you can tell who has nobler character and whose feelings are more steadfast.

Mrs. Fei Zheng hopes that her daughter can strengthen her heart and not be shaken by external interference. A true relationship is hard to come by and even more difficult to maintain.

Fei Zheng's own experience in this life has given her a deep understanding. She hopes that her daughter can have a smoother path than her own, with less psychological struggle and torture.

It is better to go through the twists and turns that you may encounter before getting married and be mentally prepared than to be completely immersed in the world of love between two people and then be shattered by the beautiful illusion.

In this society where patriarchy is supreme and men are allowed to have multiple concubines, if a wealthy family wants to completely eliminate concubines, it is somewhat of a fantasy and only a woman's wishful thinking.

Since the reality is so cruel and the treatment of women is so harsh, then as a wife, she should not just be jealous and fussy, but should be more flexible and delicate, and win over the man's heart, so that life can be truly easy.
